description: The title screen (Features WV3, P8.core; catalog onboarding-title-main-menu): Continue, New Game, Load Game, Settings and Quit, which are shown and offered from the save slots (P1.core-slots: the same slot table, Continue target and busy state the slot list draws), why one is not, where the focus goes, and what each choice asks the host to do. Nothing here does I/O. Runner: src/ui/title-flow-corpus.ts (ops menu, choose, session). Numbers compare within tolerance; everything else exactly, object key sets included (a key TypeScript leaves undefined is absent). Regenerate with npm run title-onboarding-corpora; npm run title-onboarding-corpora:check fails on any difference.
sources: godot 6599874 addons/insimul/ui/main_menu.gd (InsimulMainMenu: the entries and their order, Continue gated on a loadable slot); unreal d8b05f1 Source/InsimulRuntime/Private/InsimulMainMenuPanel.cpp and Portable/InsimulSaveSlotModel.cpp (Continue is the slot model's answer; ContinueBlockedReason); babylon bfcdeb2 packages/babylon/src/engine/game-engine/rendering/MainMenuScreen.ts (Continue is the most recent continuable save; Load Game offered when any save exists).
Core's own rules (no engine had one): New Game opens into the first empty slot; focus on the first offered entry; the platform and game flags for Quit and Settings.
Inputs are synthetic; every expected is core's answer, and src/ui/__tests__/title-flow.test.ts pins the same rules independently.

slotMessages.invalid_format: Unrecognized save format — this slot cannot be loaded.
slotMessages.missing_save_file: Save data is missing or unreadable.
slotMessages.integrity_mismatch: Save file integrity check failed — file may be corrupted or tampered.

contract.continueRule: offered when continueSlot (P1.core-slots) is not null; otherwise its reason is the message of the first corrupted slot in slot order, else "No saved game to continue."
contract.loadRule: offered when any slot is not empty (a corrupted one included); otherwise "No saved games."
contract.newGameRule: always offered; opens into the first empty manual slot (never the dedicated quick slot, PL.quick-slot), or none when every manual slot is used; carries onboarding (false only when the game turns it off)
contract.shownRule: Settings is not shown when settings is false; Quit is not shown when quit is false; a not-shown entry is refused not_shown
contract.busyRule: busy (the input flag true, or the session has a pending operation or an open delete prompt) refuses every shown entry busy and focuses nothing
contract.focusRule: the first entry, in order, that is offered
contract.titleRule: the input title trimmed, when it is a string that is not blank; otherwise the default
